cognitive_contract.label: Synthesize / cross-topic integrate (Standard Olympiad)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Synthesize two distinct mathematical topics or conceptual frameworks into a unified logical derivation to evaluate protected terminal quantity W.
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Require learner to establish the cross-topic bridge without intermediate prompting and eliminate extraneous algebraic roots.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Activate the primary structural theorem without executing the algebraic synthesis or domain filtering.

slots.X: the cross-topic synthesis of metric geometry and quadratic factoring
slots.Y: right-angled triangle with legs x, x + 7 and hypotenuse x + 8
slots.Z: unifying Pythagorean theorem a^2 + b^2 = c^2 with quadratic factorization (x - 5)(x + 3) = 0 and physical domain restriction x > 0
slots.wrong_idea: retaining extraneous negative root x = -3 or stopping after finding x = 5 without computing triangle area
slots.replacement_rule: reject x = -3 since side lengths must be positive; evaluate legs 5 and 12, giving Area = 0.5 * 5 * 12 = 30
slots.visual_job: render right triangle with algebraic side dimensions labeled; avoid decorative or unmounted SVGs
slots.check_job: verify Pythagorean identity: 5^2 + 12^2 = 25 + 144 = 169 = 13^2 = (5+8)^2. Hypotenuse matches. Area = 30 verified.

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Exact cross-topic scenario, options with authentic synthesis and domain filtering traps
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 cross-topic bridge activation, H2 tactical reduced formulation; preserves W
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; step-by-step why-valid derivation with substitution check
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with specific student misconception

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters in Core 1A text

core1b_reconstruction.model_alternation: Reconstruction must use an alternative synthesis pathway (e.g. difference-of-squares factoring rather than standard polynomial expansion)

core2a_supported_practice.transfer_obligation: Near-transfer item with identical cross-topic synthesis crux

core2b_transfer_assessment.transfer_obligation: Far-transfer item extending synthesis across 3D geometry or higher-degree Diophantine constraints
